//! Closed raw core-Patch frame verification after one paid structural scan.

use wf_domain::policy::complete::{
    CompleteCorePolicyPatchFrameHeader, CompletePolicyEncodingError, CompletePolicyRequestError,
    PolicySchemaCharge, PolicySchemaLimits,
};
use wf_domain::workflow::admission::AdmissionLimits;
use wf_domain::workflow::control::{EntryIdentity, PreparedDigest};
use wf_domain::workflow::request::gate::CommittedHeader;
use wf_types::version::LogIdentity;

/// Verified original bytes and their restored private request header.
///
/// The header and hashes are mathematical preparation, not ordered authority.
pub struct VerifiedCompleteCorePolicyPatchFrame<'a> {
    header: CompleteCorePolicyPatchFrameHeader<'a>,
    digest: PreparedDigest,
    isolation: Vec<u8>,
}

impl<'a> VerifiedCompleteCorePolicyPatchFrame<'a> {
    /// Borrows the complete immutable input without a copied frame.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn encoded(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
        self.header.encoded()
    }

    /// Borrows the original partial command without materializing a policy.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn original_intent(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
        self.header.original_intent()
    }

    /// Reads the recomputed identity of the complete frame.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn digest(&self) -> PreparedDigest {
        self.digest
    }

    /// Borrows the canonical isolation bytes owned by this result.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn isolation_scope(&self) -> &[u8] {
        &self.isolation
    }

    /// Joins a separately supplied log identity to verified frame identity.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn header(&self, log: LogIdentity) -> CommittedHeader<'_> {
        CommittedHeader {
            format_version: 1,
            scope: self.header.scope(),
            request: self.header.request(),
            intent: self.header.intent(),
            identity: EntryIdentity::new(log, self.digest),
            stamp: self.header.stamp(),
            encoded_entry: self.header.encoded(),
            encoded_isolation_scope: &self.isolation,
        }
    }
}

/// Verifies original tag-five bytes on the caller's continuous schema account.
///
/// No partial policy is expanded and no current state or request gate is read.
///
/// # Errors
/// Preserves structural, profile, work, intent and fallible scope-output refusals.
pub fn verify_complete_core_policy_patch_frame<'a>(
    _encoded: &'a [u8],
    _limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    _admission: AdmissionLimits,
    _charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<VerifiedCompleteCorePolicyPatchFrame<'a>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed.into())
}
```

//! Borrowed mathematical admission and paid header restoration for tag-five frames.

use wf_types::identity::{GroupId, RecoveryId, RequestId, TenantId};
use wf_types::version::CommittedTime;

use crate::workflow::admission::AdmissionLimits;
use crate::workflow::request::{ClientIntent, RequestScope};

use super::super::admission::charge_schema;
use super::super::{
    CompletePolicyEncodingError, PolicySchemaCharge, PolicySchemaError, PolicySchemaLimits,
};
use super::CompletePolicyRequestError;

mod scan;

/// Immutable structure from one original frame; carries no account or paid credit.
pub struct ScannedCorePatchFrame<'a> {
    encoded: &'a [u8],
    original_intent: &'a [u8],
    tenant: &'a [u8],
    group: &'a [u8],
    recovery: &'a [u8],
    request: &'a [u8],
    stamp: CommittedTime,
    intent_digest: [u8; 32],
}

impl<'a> ScannedCorePatchFrame<'a> {
    /// Borrows the exact original partial-command identity bytes for recomputation.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn original_intent(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
        self.original_intent
    }
}

/// Owned identities and borrowed original bytes, without prepared-frame authority.
pub struct CompleteCorePolicyPatchFrameHeader<'a> {
    encoded: &'a [u8],
    original_intent: &'a [u8],
    scope: RequestScope,
    request: RequestId,
    stamp: CommittedTime,
    intent: ClientIntent,
}

impl<'a> CompleteCorePolicyPatchFrameHeader<'a> {
    /// Borrows the same complete original frame.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn encoded(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
        self.encoded
    }

    /// Borrows the original partial command, without materializing a Patch.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn original_intent(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
        self.original_intent
    }

    /// Borrows independently owned validated namespace identities.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn scope(&self) -> &RequestScope {
        &self.scope
    }

    /// Borrows the original caller request identity.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn request(&self) -> &RequestId {
        &self.request
    }

    /// Reads the structurally validated committed stamp.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn stamp(&self) -> CommittedTime {
        self.stamp
    }

    /// Reads the supplied intent after its paid recomputed-digest comparison.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn intent(&self) -> ClientIntent {
        self.intent
    }
}

/// Scans one complete original frame through the received schema account.
///
/// The result is mathematical structure, with no hash computation or paid credit.
/// Structural scope admission precedes intent recomputation and all owned headers.
///
/// # Errors
/// Preserves profile, frame, scope, wire, work and checked-length refusals.
pub fn scan_complete_core_policy_patch_frame<'a>(
    encoded: &'a [u8],
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<ScannedCorePatchFrame<'a>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    if charge.profile() != limits {
        return Err(PolicySchemaError::ProfileMismatch.into());
    }
    if encoded.len() > admission.decision_bytes() {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit.into());
    }
    let (scanned, inner_tenant) = scan::scan_frame(encoded, limits, charge)?;
    let comparison = scanned
        .tenant
        .len()
        .checked_add(inner_tenant.len())
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    let comparison = comparison
        .checked_add(128)
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    let comparison = u64::try_from(comparison).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    charge_schema(charge, comparison, 0)?;
    if scanned.tenant != inner_tenant {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed.into());
    }
    let bytes =
        u64::try_from(scanned.original_intent.len()).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    let hash = bytes
        .checked_add(128)
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    charge_schema(charge, hash, 0)?;
    Ok(scanned)
}

/// Consumes one same-frame view after fresh comparison and header/tail admissions.
///
/// No grammar scan is repeated. This header cannot mint a ports Verified value.
/// Public calls do not establish account identity; the closed raw ports entry
/// threads its actual account through every scan, comparison, copy and tail.
///
/// # Errors
/// Rechecks profile/frame caps, then preserves digest, copy and work refusals.
pub fn restore_complete_core_policy_patch_frame_header<'a>(
    scanned: ScannedCorePatchFrame<'a>,
    recomputed: [u8; 32],
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<CompleteCorePolicyPatchFrameHeader<'a>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    if charge.profile() != limits {
        return Err(PolicySchemaError::ProfileMismatch.into());
    }
    if scanned.encoded.len() > admission.decision_bytes() {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit.into());
    }
    charge_schema(charge, 192, 0)?;
    if recomputed != scanned.intent_digest {
        return Err(CompletePolicyRequestError::IntentMismatch);
    }
    let header = restore_header(scanned, charge)?;
    prepare_tail(&header, charge)?;
    Ok(header)
}

fn copy_header_field(
    bytes: &[u8],
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let bytes_len = u64::try_from(bytes.len()).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    let work = bytes_len
        .checked_add(128)
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    charge_schema(charge, work, 0)?;
    let mut copied = Vec::new();
    copied
        .try_reserve_exact(bytes.len())
        .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::AllocationFailure))?;
    copied.extend_from_slice(bytes);
    Ok(copied)
}

fn restore_header<'a>(
    scanned: ScannedCorePatchFrame<'a>,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<CompleteCorePolicyPatchFrameHeader<'a>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let ScannedCorePatchFrame {
        encoded,
        original_intent,
        tenant,
        group,
        recovery,
        request,
        stamp,
        intent_digest,
    } = scanned;
    charge_schema(charge, 128, 0)?;
    charge_schema(charge, 128, 0)?;
    let tenant = TenantId::new(copy_header_field(tenant, charge)?)
        .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed))?;
    let group = GroupId::new(copy_header_field(group, charge)?)
        .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed))?;
    let recovery = RecoveryId::new(copy_header_field(recovery, charge)?)
        .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed))?;
    let scope = RequestScope::new(tenant, group, recovery);
    let request = RequestId::new(copy_header_field(request, charge)?)
        .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed))?;
    Ok(CompleteCorePolicyPatchFrameHeader {
        encoded,
        original_intent,
        scope,
        request,
        stamp,
        intent: ClientIntent::complete_core_policy_patch(intent_digest),
    })
}

fn prepare_tail(
    header: &CompleteCorePolicyPatchFrameHeader<'_>,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    charge_schema(charge, 128, 0)?;
    let isolation = header
        .scope
        .tenant()
        .as_bytes()
        .len()
        .checked_add(header.scope.group().as_bytes().len())
        .ok_or(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit)?;
    let isolation = isolation
        .checked_add(header.scope.recovery().as_bytes().len())
        .ok_or(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit)?;
    let isolation = isolation
        .checked_add(18)
        .ok_or(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit)?;
    if isolation > 8_192 {
        return Err(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit);
    }
    let bytes = u64::try_from(isolation).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    // Distinct scope measure, reserve, and emission occurrences.
    for base in [512, 128, 512] {
        let work = bytes
            .checked_add(base)
            .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
        charge_schema(charge, work, 0)?;
    }
    let frame_len =
        u64::try_from(header.encoded.len()).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    let frame = frame_len
        .checked_add(128)
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    charge_schema(charge, frame, 0)?;
    Ok(())
}

//! One paid borrowed walk over complete frame structure and original Patch grammar.

use wf_types::version::{CommittedTime, HlcTimestamp};

use super::super::super::encoding::reader::Reader;
use super::super::super::{
    CompletePolicyEncodingError, PolicySchemaCharge, PolicySchemaError, PolicySchemaLimits,
};
use super::{CompletePolicyRequestError, ScannedCorePatchFrame};

pub(super) fn scan_frame<'a>(
    encoded: &'a [u8],
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<(ScannedCorePatchFrame<'a>, &'a [u8]), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let (scanned, inner_tenant) = {
        let mut reader = Reader::new(encoded, limits, charge);
        reader.node()?;
        if reader.take(4)? != b"FWCP" {
            return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed.into());
        }
        if reader.u16()? != 1 {
            return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedVersion.into());
        }
        if reader.byte()? != 5 {
            return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedTag.into());
        }
        let tenant = reader.raw(8_192)?;
        tenant
            .first()
            .ok_or(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed)?;
        let group = reader.raw(256)?;
        group
            .first()
            .ok_or(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed)?;
        let recovery = reader.raw(256)?;
        recovery
            .first()
            .ok_or(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed)?;
        let isolation = tenant
            .len()
            .checked_add(group.len())
            .ok_or(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit)?;
        let isolation = isolation
            .checked_add(recovery.len())
            .ok_or(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit)?;
        let isolation = isolation
            .checked_add(18)
            .ok_or(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit)?;
        if isolation > 8_192 {
            return Err(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit);
        }
        let request = reader.raw(256)?;
        request
            .first()
            .ok_or(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed)?;
        if reader.u16()? != 2 {
            return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedVersion.into());
        }
        let intent_digest = reader
            .take(32)?
            .try_into()
            .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed))?;
        let hlc = HlcTimestamp::new(reader.u64()?, reader.u16()?)
            .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed))?;
        let stamp = CommittedTime::new(hlc, reader.u64()?)
            .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed))?;
        reader.node()?;
        let declared = reader.u32()?;
        if declared > 1_048_576 {
            return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit.into());
        }
        let n = usize::try_from(declared).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
        let start = reader.position();
        let end = start
            .checked_add(n)
            .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
        if end > encoded.len() {
            return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed.into());
        }
        if end < encoded.len() {
            return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::TrailingBytes.into());
        }
        let original_intent = &encoded[start..end];
        let inner_tenant = {
            let mut intent = reader.region(start..end)?;
            let tenant = scan_intent(&mut intent)?;
            intent.finish()?;
            tenant
        };
        let scanned = ScannedCorePatchFrame {
            encoded,
            original_intent,
            tenant,
            group,
            recovery,
            request,
            stamp,
            intent_digest,
        };
        (scanned, inner_tenant)
    };
    Ok((scanned, inner_tenant))
}

fn scan_intent<'a>(reader: &mut Reader<'a, '_>) -> Result<&'a [u8], CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    reader.node()?;
    if reader.take(33)? != b"WF-INTENT\0COMPLETE-CORE-PATCH\0V2\0" {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed);
    }
    let tenant = reader.raw(8_192)?;
    if tenant.is_empty() {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed);
    }
    if scan_optional(reader)? {
        reader.u64()?;
    }
    reader.node()?;
    reader.raw(262_144)?;
    if scan_field_patch(reader)? == 1 {
        scan_version(reader)?;
    }
    if scan_field_patch(reader)? == 1 {
        reader.u64()?;
    }
    if scan_field_patch(reader)? == 1 {
        scan_retry(reader)?;
    }
    if scan_field_patch(reader)? == 1 {
        scan_retention(reader)?;
    }
    scan_state_changes(reader)?;
    Ok(tenant)
}

fn scan_field_patch(reader: &mut Reader<'_, '_>) -> Result<u8, CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    let tag = reader.byte()?;
    match tag {
        0 | 2 => Ok(tag),
        1 => {
            reader.node()?;
            Ok(tag)
        }
        _ => Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedTag),
    }
}

fn scan_optional(reader: &mut Reader<'_, '_>) -> Result<bool, CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    match reader.byte()? {
        0 => Ok(false),
        1 => {
            reader.node()?;
            Ok(true)
        }
        _ => Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::InvalidOptionality),
    }
}

fn scan_version(reader: &mut Reader<'_, '_>) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    match reader.byte()? {
        0 => {
            reader.raw(262_144)?;
        }
        1 => {
            reader.u64()?;
        }
        _ => return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedTag),
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn scan_retry(reader: &mut Reader<'_, '_>) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    reader.node()?;
    if scan_optional(reader)? {
        reader.u16()?;
    }
    if scan_optional(reader)? {
        scan_backoff(reader)?;
    }
    if scan_optional(reader)? {
        reader.raw(262_144)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn scan_backoff(reader: &mut Reader<'_, '_>) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    reader.node()?;
    if scan_optional(reader)? && reader.byte()? > 3 {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedTag);
    }
    if scan_optional(reader)? {
        reader.u64()?;
    }
    if scan_optional(reader)? {
        reader.u64()?;
    }
    if scan_optional(reader)? {
        reader.byte()?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn scan_retention(reader: &mut Reader<'_, '_>) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    reader.node()?;
    if scan_optional(reader)? {
        reader.u64()?;
    }
    if scan_optional(reader)? {
        reader.u32()?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn scan_state_changes(reader: &mut Reader<'_, '_>) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    let count = reader.count(usize::MAX)?;
    let mut previous = None;
    for _ in 0..count {
        reader.node()?;
        let key = reader.raw(262_144)?;
        if let Some(previous) = previous {
            reader.keys(previous, key, 262_144)?;
        }
        match reader.byte()? {
            0 => {}
            1 => scan_state_patch(reader)?,
            _ => return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedTag),
        }
        previous = Some(key);
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn scan_state_patch(reader: &mut Reader<'_, '_>) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    reader.node()?;
    if scan_field_patch(reader)? == 1 && reader.byte()? > 1 {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedTag);
    }
    if scan_field_patch(reader)? == 1 {
        scan_retry(reader)?;
    }
    if scan_field_patch(reader)? == 1 {
        scan_retention(reader)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

use wf_types::identity::{GroupId, RecoveryId, RequestId, TenantId};
use wf_types::version::CommittedTime;

use crate::workflow::admission::AdmissionLimits;
use crate::workflow::request::{ClientIntent, RequestScope};

use super::super::admission::charge_schema;
use super::super::{
    CompletePolicyEncodingError, PolicySchemaCharge, PolicySchemaError, PolicySchemaLimits,
};

mod scan;

/// Immutable structure from one original frame; carries no account or paid credit.
pub struct ScannedCorePatchFrame<'a> {
    encoded: &'a [u8],
    original_intent: &'a [u8],
    tenant: &'a [u8],
    group: &'a [u8],
    recovery: &'a [u8],
    request: &'a [u8],
    stamp: CommittedTime,
    intent_digest: [u8; 32],
}

impl<'a> ScannedCorePatchFrame<'a> {
    /// Borrows the exact original partial-command identity bytes for recomputation.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn original_intent(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
        self.original_intent
    }

    fn restore_header(
        self,
        charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
    ) -> Result<CompleteCorePolicyPatchFrameHeader<'a>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        let ScannedCorePatchFrame {
            encoded,
            original_intent,
            tenant,
            group,
            recovery,
            request,
            stamp,
            intent_digest,
        } = self;
        charge_schema(charge, 128, 0)?;
        charge_schema(charge, 128, 0)?;
        let tenant = TenantId::new(copy_header_field(tenant, charge)?)
            .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed))?;
        let group = GroupId::new(copy_header_field(group, charge)?)
            .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed))?;
        let recovery = RecoveryId::new(copy_header_field(recovery, charge)?)
            .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed))?;
        let scope = RequestScope::new(tenant, group, recovery);
        let request = RequestId::new(copy_header_field(request, charge)?)
            .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed))?;
        Ok(CompleteCorePolicyPatchFrameHeader {
            encoded,
            original_intent,
            scope,
            request,
            stamp,
            intent: ClientIntent::complete_core_policy_patch(intent_digest),
        })
    }
}

/// Owned identities and borrowed original bytes, without prepared-frame authority.
pub struct CompleteCorePolicyPatchFrameHeader<'a> {
    encoded: &'a [u8],
    original_intent: &'a [u8],
    scope: RequestScope,
    request: RequestId,
    stamp: CommittedTime,
    intent: ClientIntent,
}

impl<'a> CompleteCorePolicyPatchFrameHeader<'a> {
    /// Borrows the same complete original frame.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn encoded(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
        self.encoded
    }

    /// Borrows the original partial command, without materializing a Patch.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn original_intent(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
        self.original_intent
    }

    /// Borrows independently owned validated namespace identities.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn scope(&self) -> &RequestScope {
        &self.scope
    }

    /// Borrows the original caller request identity.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn request(&self) -> &RequestId {
        &self.request
    }

    /// Reads the structurally validated committed stamp.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn stamp(&self) -> CommittedTime {
        self.stamp
    }

    /// Reads the supplied intent after its paid recomputed-digest comparison.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn intent(&self) -> ClientIntent {
        self.intent
    }
}

/// Scans one complete original frame through the received schema account.
///
/// The result is mathematical structure, with no hash computation or paid credit.
/// Structural scope admission precedes intent recomputation and all owned headers.
///
/// # Errors
/// Preserves profile, frame, scope, wire, work and checked-length refusals.
pub fn scan_complete_core_policy_patch_frame<'a>(
    encoded: &'a [u8],
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<ScannedCorePatchFrame<'a>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    if charge.profile() != limits {
        return Err(PolicySchemaError::ProfileMismatch.into());
    }
    if encoded.len() > admission.decision_bytes() {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit.into());
    }
    let (scanned, inner_tenant) = scan::scan_frame(encoded, limits, charge)?;
    let comparison = scanned
        .tenant
        .len()
        .checked_add(inner_tenant.len())
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    let comparison = comparison
        .checked_add(128)
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    let comparison = u64::try_from(comparison).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    charge_schema(charge, comparison, 0)?;
    if scanned.tenant != inner_tenant {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed.into());
    }
    let bytes =
        u64::try_from(scanned.original_intent.len()).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    let hash = bytes
        .checked_add(128)
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    charge_schema(charge, hash, 0)?;
    Ok(scanned)
}

/// Consumes one same-frame view after fresh comparison and header/tail admissions.
///
/// No grammar scan is repeated. This header cannot mint a ports Verified value.
/// Public calls do not establish account identity; the closed raw ports entry
/// threads its actual account through every scan, comparison, copy and tail.
///
/// # Errors
/// Rechecks profile/frame caps, then preserves digest, copy and work refusals.
pub fn restore_complete_core_policy_patch_frame_header<'a>(
    scanned: ScannedCorePatchFrame<'a>,
    recomputed: [u8; 32],
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<CompleteCorePolicyPatchFrameHeader<'a>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    if charge.profile() != limits {
        return Err(PolicySchemaError::ProfileMismatch.into());
    }
    if scanned.encoded.len() > admission.decision_bytes() {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit.into());
    }
    charge_schema(charge, 192, 0)?;
    if recomputed != scanned.intent_digest {
        return Err(CompletePolicyRequestError::IntentMismatch);
    }
    let header = scanned.restore_header(charge)?;
    prepare_tail(&header, charge)?;
    Ok(header)
}

fn copy_header_field(
    bytes: &[u8],
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let bytes_len = u64::try_from(bytes.len()).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    let work = bytes_len
        .checked_add(128)
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    charge_schema(charge, work, 0)?;
    let mut copied = Vec::new();
    copied
        .try_reserve_exact(bytes.len())
        .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::AllocationFailure))?;
    copied.extend_from_slice(bytes);
    Ok(copied)
}

fn prepare_tail(
    header: &CompleteCorePolicyPatchFrameHeader<'_>,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    charge_schema(charge, 128, 0)?;
    let isolation = header
        .scope
        .tenant()
        .as_bytes()
        .len()
        .checked_add(header.scope.group().as_bytes().len())
        .ok_or(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit)?;
    let isolation = isolation
        .checked_add(header.scope.recovery().as_bytes().len())
        .ok_or(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit)?;
    let isolation = isolation
        .checked_add(18)
        .ok_or(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit)?;
    if isolation > 8_192 {
        return Err(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit);
    }
    let bytes = u64::try_from(isolation).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    // Distinct scope measure, reserve, and emission occurrences.
    for base in [512, 128, 512] {
        let work = bytes
            .checked_add(base)
            .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
        charge_schema(charge, work, 0)?;
    }
    let frame_len =
        u64::try_from(header.encoded.len()).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    let frame = frame_len
        .checked_add(128)
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    charge_schema(charge, frame, 0)?;
    Ok(())
}

```rust
//! Header-only replay gate shared by fresh record/policy/index operation dispatch.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;

use wf_types::identity::RequestId;
use wf_types::version::CommittedTime;

use super::{ClientIntent, RequestScope, RetainedOutcome};
use crate::policy::complete::{PolicySchemaCharge, PolicySchemaError, PolicySchemaLimits};
use crate::workflow::admission::{AdmissionLimits, MAX_ENCODED_ISOLATION_SCOPE_BYTES};
use crate::workflow::batch::ApplyError;
use crate::workflow::control::{
    ControlPlan, ControlState, EntryIdentity, EntryStamp, plan_control,
};

/// Immutable original request header, verified from private committed bytes.
///
/// Public requests require a trusted committed stamp. Consensus unstamped entries
/// are representable only through the separate nonrequest control API.
///
/// ```compile_fail
/// use wf_domain::workflow::request::gate::CommittedHeader;
/// use wf_domain::workflow::control::EntryStamp;
/// fn unstamped(header: &mut CommittedHeader<'_>) {
///     header.stamp = EntryStamp::Unstamped;
/// }
/// ```
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct CommittedHeader<'a> {
    /// Private committed schema version, separate from public wire.
    pub format_version: u16,
    /// Original server-bound tenant/group/recovery namespace.
    pub scope: &'a RequestScope,
    /// Stable request identity in the original namespace.
    pub request: &'a RequestId,
    /// Canonical client intent, excluding generated/time inputs.
    pub intent: ClientIntent,
    /// Full log identity and separately verified prepared bytes digest.
    pub identity: EntryIdentity,
    /// Required trusted stamp; unstamped requests are unrepresentable.
    pub stamp: CommittedTime,
    /// Actual immutable entry bytes, whose field binding the decoder verifies.
    pub encoded_entry: &'a [u8],
    /// Actual isolation-scope bytes, whose typed binding the decoder verifies.
    pub encoded_isolation_scope: &'a [u8],
}

/// Coherent retained/control authority before any current operation guards.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct GateView<'a> {
    /// Current server-bound tenant/group/recovery namespace.
    pub scope: &'a RequestScope,
    /// Persisted time/full last-entry/checkpoint values.
    pub control: ControlState,
    /// Unique authoritative retained outcomes in this exact namespace.
    pub outcomes: &'a BTreeMap<RequestId, RetainedOutcome>,
}

/// Replay inspection result; fresh operation dispatch has not executed yet.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum GateDecision<'a> {
    /// Run the bounded operation reducer at the returned effective execution time.
    Fresh,
    /// Borrow the exact original response owner before all changed guards.
    Replay(&'a RetainedOutcome),
    /// Different canonical intent; preserve the original outcome.
    IntentConflict,
    /// Retention expired; never reexecute this still-retained identity.
    Expired,
    /// Exact last log identity/bytes/stamp; publish no metadata or operation writes.
    LogReplay,
}

/// Proposed control and gate decision; no fresh semantic outcome exists yet.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RequestGate<'a> {
    control: ControlPlan,
    decision: GateDecision<'a>,
}
impl<'a> RequestGate<'a> {
    /// Reads proposed processing time/checkpoint independently of original outcome.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn control(self) -> ControlPlan {
        self.control
    }
    /// Reads fresh permission or borrowed original replay decision.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn decision(self) -> GateDecision<'a> {
        self.decision
    }
}

/// Inspects scoped replay before any record, policy-generation or index guards.
///
/// Current authorization and private byte/digest verification precede this API.
/// Only `Fresh` dispatches a new bounded operation; errors leave durable authority
/// unchanged. Fresh semantic result bytes/control must later persist atomically.
///
/// # Errors
/// Rejects foreign/corrupt committed authority and conflicting log identity.
pub fn inspect_request<'view>(
    view: GateView<'view>,
    header: CommittedHeader<'_>,
    limits: AdmissionLimits,
) -> Result<RequestGate<'view>, ApplyError> {
    if header.format_version != 1
        || view.scope != header.scope
        || header.encoded_entry.len() > limits.decision_bytes()
        || header.encoded_isolation_scope.len() > MAX_ENCODED_ISOLATION_SCOPE_BYTES
        || (view.control.last_entry().is_none() && !view.outcomes.is_empty())
    {
        return Err(ApplyError::InvalidAuthority);
    }
    let control = plan_control(
        view.control,
        header.identity,
        EntryStamp::Stamped(header.stamp),
    )?;
    if control.is_log_replay() {
        return Ok(RequestGate {
            control,
            decision: GateDecision::LogReplay,
        });
    }
    let decision = if let Some(retained) = view.outcomes.get(header.request) {
        if &retained.scope != view.scope
            || &retained.request != header.request
            || retained.original_position.index() > view.control.position()
            || retained.original_time > view.control.time().hlc().physical()
            || retained.response.len() > limits.decision_bytes()
        {
            return Err(ApplyError::InvalidAuthority);
        }
        if retained.intent != header.intent {
            GateDecision::IntentConflict
        } else if control.execution_time() >= retained.expires_at {
            GateDecision::Expired
        } else {
            GateDecision::Replay(retained)
        }
    } else {
        GateDecision::Fresh
    };
    Ok(RequestGate { control, decision })
}

/// Operational charged inspection refusal; it grants no execution authority.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum ChargedRequestGateError {
    /// Profile, checked logical arithmetic or work admission refused.
    Schema(PolicySchemaError),
    /// Header, retained or committed control authority refused.
    Apply(ApplyError),
}

impl std::fmt::Display for ChargedRequestGateError {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::Schema(error) => std::fmt::Display::fmt(error, formatter),
            Self::Apply(error) => std::fmt::Display::fmt(error, formatter),
        }
    }
}
impl std::error::Error for ChargedRequestGateError {}

/// Inspects one original header on the caller's continuous schema account.
///
/// Mathematical header fields do not certify private byte binding or payment.
/// The raw ports parent must freshly verify before this one inspection.
///
/// # Errors
/// Preserves profile/work/length refusal and existing operational gate priority.
pub fn inspect_complete_core_policy_patch_gate<'view>(
    _view: GateView<'view>,
    _header: CommittedHeader<'_>,
    _limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    _admission: AdmissionLimits,
    _charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<RequestGate<'view>, ChargedRequestGateError> {
    Err(ChargedRequestGateError::Apply(ApplyError::InvalidAuthority))
}
```

//! Rejecting S0 interface only; no request behavior or authority is implemented.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::fmt;

use wf_types::version::{LogIdentity, TimestampMillis};

use crate::workflow::admission::AdmissionLimits;
use crate::workflow::batch::ApplyError;
use crate::workflow::request::gate::GateView;
use crate::workflow::request::{ClientIntent, RequestValueError, RetainedOutcome};

use super::{
    CompleteCorePolicyPatchRequestInput, CompletePolicyRequestError, CompletePolicyValue,
    PolicySchemaCharge, PolicySchemaLimits,
};

/// Supplied results from one coherent namespace/revision; no reader is implemented.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyView<'view> {
    /// Retained/control authority inspected before current policy materialization.
    pub gate: GateView<'view>,
    /// Required current snapshot revision, with no missing-value sentinel.
    pub revision: u64,
    /// Present values or operational read refusals; absent keys mean actual absence.
    pub policies: &'view BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, Result<CompletePolicyValue, ApplyError>>,
    /// Same-type active migration generations or operational reader refusals.
    pub active_migrations: &'view BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, Result<u64, ApplyError>>,
    /// Same-type completed migration generations or operational reader refusals.
    pub completed_migrations: &'view BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, Result<u64, ApplyError>>,
    /// Captured contextual history bound or its original operational refusal.
    pub history_max_events_limit: Result<u32, ApplyError>,
    /// Captured original outcome window or its original operational refusal.
    pub outcome_retention_ms: Result<u64, ApplyError>,
}

/// Proposed optional policy/predecessor and immutable original retained outcome.
pub type CompleteCorePolicyPatchFresh = (Option<(u64, CompletePolicyValue)>, RetainedOutcome);

/// Operational composition failure; no partial parent is returned.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError {
    /// Private request, complete schema, encoding or continuous-account refusal.
    Request(CompletePolicyRequestError),
    /// Current/read/context/control authority failed operationally.
    Apply(ApplyError),
    /// Original outcome construction failed without a retained status.
    Outcome(RequestValueError),
}

impl fmt::Display for CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::Request(error) => fmt::Display::fmt(error, formatter),
            Self::Apply(error) => fmt::Display::fmt(error, formatter),
            Self::Outcome(error) => fmt::Display::fmt(error, formatter),
        }
    }
}
impl std::error::Error for CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError {}

/// Rejecting S0 Fresh interface before substantive request behavior.
///
/// # Errors
/// Always returns operational invalid authority without a proposed outcome.
pub fn prepare_complete_core_policy_patch_fresh(
    view: CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyView<'_>,
    input: CompleteCorePolicyPatchRequestInput,
    committed: (ClientIntent, LogIdentity, TimestampMillis),
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<CompleteCorePolicyPatchFresh, CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError> {
    let _ = (view, input, committed, limits, admission, charge);
    Err(CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError::Apply(
        ApplyError::InvalidAuthority,
    ))
}

```rust
//! Rejecting S0 interface only; no verifier, gate or Fresh reducer is implemented.

use wf_domain::policy::complete::{
    CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError, CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyView,
    CompleteCorePolicyPatchFresh, PolicySchemaCharge, PolicySchemaLimits,
};
use wf_domain::workflow::admission::AdmissionLimits;
use wf_domain::workflow::control::{ControlPlan, ControlState};
use wf_domain::workflow::request::DispatchDecision;
use wf_types::version::LogIdentity;

/// Complete mathematical parent with original reply and coherent compare inputs.
///
/// No public constructor, transaction or durable publication is supplied.
pub struct CompleteCorePolicyPatchRequestPlan<'view> {
    expected_revision: u64,
    base_control: ControlState,
    control: ControlPlan,
    decision: DispatchDecision<'view, CompleteCorePolicyPatchFresh>,
}

impl<'view> CompleteCorePolicyPatchRequestPlan<'view> {
    /// Reads the exact coherent snapshot revision required by later atomic commit.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn expected_revision(&self) -> u64 {
        self.expected_revision
    }

    /// Reads original control authority required by the later atomic comparison.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn base_control(&self) -> ControlState {
        self.base_control
    }

    /// Reads proposed control; exact log replay proposes no publication.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn control(&self) -> ControlPlan {
        self.control
    }

    /// Borrows Fresh owners or the exact original view-borrowed replay outcome.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn decision(&self) -> &DispatchDecision<'view, CompleteCorePolicyPatchFresh> {
        &self.decision
    }

    /// Moves all proposed owners and compare inputs without copying reply bytes.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn into_parts(
        self,
    ) -> (
        u64,
        ControlState,
        ControlPlan,
        DispatchDecision<'view, CompleteCorePolicyPatchFresh>,
    ) {
        (
            self.expected_revision,
            self.base_control,
            self.control,
            self.decision,
        )
    }
}

/// Rejecting S0 raw interface before substantive request behavior.
///
/// # Errors
/// Always returns operational invalid authority without a proposed parent.
pub fn decide_complete_core_policy_patch_frame<'view>(
    view: CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyView<'view>,
    encoded: &[u8],
    log: LogIdentity,
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<CompleteCorePolicyPatchRequestPlan<'view>, CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError> {
    let _ = (view, encoded, log, limits, admission, charge);
    Err(CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError::Apply(
        wf_domain::workflow::batch::ApplyError::InvalidAuthority,
    ))
}

//! Borrowed public policy response values with captured configuration defaults.

use crate::policy::definition::{PolicyVersion, StateMode};
use crate::policy::{Backoff, RetryOverride};
use crate::retention::{MAX_HISTORY_EVENTS, ResolvedRetention, RetentionOverride};

use super::admission::charge_schema;
use super::{
    CompletePolicyData, CompletePolicyEncodingError, CompletePolicyValue, CompleteStatePolicyData,
    GovernanceData, PolicySchemaCharge, PolicySchemaError, PolicySchemaLimits,
    verify_complete_policy_value_v2,
};

/// Resolved retry scalars and an original or static exhaustion target.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct PresentedRetry<'v> {
    /// Inclusive retry count after default, type and state resolution.
    pub max_retries: u16,
    /// Fully normalized selected backoff.
    pub backoff: Backoff,
    /// Original selected owner, or the static source default.
    pub exhausted_to: &'v [u8],
}

/// One declared state in an all-state policy response.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct PresentedPolicyState<'v> {
    /// Original opaque declared state name.
    pub state: &'v [u8],
    /// State execution mode, defaulting to parallel.
    pub mode: StateMode,
    /// Type-only duration; absence means infinity.
    pub max_active_ms: Option<u64>,
    /// Default, type and state retry resolution.
    pub retry: PresentedRetry<'v>,
    /// Public retention, with no internal hot-history field.
    pub retention: ResolvedRetention,
    /// Only this state's raw group; type governance is not inherited here.
    pub governance: Option<&'v GovernanceData>,
}

/// Pure presentation; no transport, installed authority or retained replay proof.
///
/// Query bytes and immutable policy leaves have independent owner lifetimes.
/// The all-state vector owns descriptors only, never copied policy leaves.
#[derive(Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum CompletePolicyPresentation<'v, 'q> {
    /// Type response including every declared state in binary key order.
    All {
        /// Original admitted requested workflow type.
        workflow_type: &'q [u8],
        /// Stored internal generation, or zero for actual absence.
        generation: u64,
        /// Original customer version without numeric filtering.
        version: Option<&'v PolicyVersion>,
        /// Type-only duration; absence means infinity.
        max_active_ms: Option<u64>,
        /// Default and type retry resolution.
        retry: PresentedRetry<'v>,
        /// Captured default and type public retention.
        retention: ResolvedRetention,
        /// Original normalized names; absence presents as an empty list.
        indexed_attributes: &'v [Vec<u8>],
        /// Original optional normalized metadata key.
        indexed_state_meta: Option<&'v [u8]>,
        /// Original optional type governance group.
        governance: Option<&'v GovernanceData>,
        /// Every declared state; each row retains its original leaf owners.
        states: Vec<PresentedPolicyState<'v>>,
    },
    /// Selected-state response; unknown and empty states use type fallback.
    State {
        /// Original admitted requested workflow type.
        workflow_type: &'q [u8],
        /// Original query bytes, independent of the policy owner's lifetime.
        state: &'q [u8],
        /// Stored internal generation, or zero for actual absence.
        generation: u64,
        /// Original customer version without numeric filtering.
        version: Option<&'v PolicyVersion>,
        /// Selected state mode, defaulting to parallel.
        mode: StateMode,
        /// Type-only duration; absence means infinity.
        max_active_ms: Option<u64>,
        /// Default, type and selected-state retry resolution.
        retry: PresentedRetry<'v>,
        /// Captured default, type and selected-state public retention.
        retention: ResolvedRetention,
        /// Original normalized names; absence presents as an empty list.
        indexed_attributes: &'v [Vec<u8>],
        /// Original optional normalized metadata key.
        indexed_state_meta: Option<&'v [u8]>,
        /// Whole state group if present, otherwise the whole type group.
        governance: Option<&'v GovernanceData>,
    },
}

/// Presents a complete normalized policy or explicitly absent policy.
///
/// Captured public retention defaults are admitted inputs; this function reads
/// no environment. It verifies present V2 content once on the received account.
/// Raw governance groups are presented, without per-field governance resolution.
///
/// # Errors
/// Preserves profile, current encoding and prospective work failures. Invalid
/// type/default/query operands or a foreign current type return invalid authority.
/// No partial response is returned; admitted work and prior peak remain paid.
pub fn present_complete_policy<'v, 'q>(
    workflow_type: &'q [u8],
    value: Option<&'v CompletePolicyValue>,
    state: Option<&'q [u8]>,
    defaults: ResolvedRetention,
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<CompletePolicyPresentation<'v, 'q>, CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    use CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema;

    if charge.profile() != limits {
        return Err(Schema(PolicySchemaError::ProfileMismatch));
    }
    charge_schema(charge, 128, 0).map_err(Schema)?;
    let default_overrides = RetentionOverride {
        ttl_ms: Some(defaults.ttl_ms),
        history_max_events: Some(defaults.history_max_events),
    };
    if workflow_type.is_empty()
        || workflow_type.len() > 262_144
        || default_overrides.validate(MAX_HISTORY_EVENTS).is_err()
    {
        return Err(Schema(PolicySchemaError::InvalidAuthority));
    }
    let n = u64::try_from(workflow_type.len())
        .map_err(|_| Schema(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    charge_schema(charge, n, 0).map_err(Schema)?;
    if let Some(value) = value {
        verify_complete_policy_value_v2(value, limits, charge)?;
        charge_schema(
            charge,
            n.checked_add(128)
                .ok_or(Schema(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?,
            0,
        )
        .map_err(Schema)?;
        if value.data().workflow_type != workflow_type {
            return Err(Schema(PolicySchemaError::InvalidAuthority));
        }
    }
    present_projection(workflow_type, value, state, defaults, charge)
}

fn present_projection<'v, 'q>(
    workflow_type: &'q [u8],
    value: Option<&'v CompletePolicyValue>,
    state: Option<&'q [u8]>,
    defaults: ResolvedRetention,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<CompletePolicyPresentation<'v, 'q>, CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    use CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema;

    let data = value.map(CompletePolicyValue::data);
    let selected = if let Some(state) = state {
        if state.len() > 262_144 {
            return Err(Schema(PolicySchemaError::InvalidAuthority));
        }
        let n =
            u64::try_from(state.len()).map_err(|_| Schema(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
        charge_schema(
            charge,
            n.checked_add(128)
                .ok_or(Schema(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?,
            0,
        )
        .map_err(Schema)?;
        data.and_then(|data| data.states.get(state))
    } else {
        None
    };
    charge_schema(charge, 128, 0).map_err(Schema)?;
    let generation = value.map_or(0, CompletePolicyValue::generation);
    let version = data.and_then(|data| data.version.as_ref());
    let max_active_ms = data.and_then(|data| data.max_active_ms);
    let retry = present_retry(data.and_then(|data| data.retry.as_ref()), selected);
    let retention = present_retention(defaults, data.and_then(|data| data.retention), selected);
    let indexed_attributes = data
        .and_then(|data| data.indexed_attributes.as_deref())
        .unwrap_or(&[]);
    let indexed_state_meta = data.and_then(|data| data.indexed_state_meta.as_deref());
    let governance = data.and_then(|data| data.governance.as_ref());
    if let Some(state) = state {
        return Ok(CompletePolicyPresentation::State {
            workflow_type,
            state,
            generation,
            version,
            mode: selected
                .and_then(|state| state.mode)
                .unwrap_or(StateMode::Parallel),
            max_active_ms,
            retry,
            retention,
            indexed_attributes,
            indexed_state_meta,
            governance: selected
                .and_then(|state| state.governance.as_ref())
                .or(governance),
        });
    }
    let count = data.map_or(0, |data| data.states.len());
    let reserve = u64::try_from(count)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|count| count.checked_mul(128))
        .and_then(|work| work.checked_add(128))
        .ok_or(Schema(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    charge_schema(charge, reserve, 0).map_err(Schema)?;
    let mut states = Vec::new();
    states
        .try_reserve_exact(count)
        .map_err(|_| CompletePolicyEncodingError::AllocationFailure)?;
    if let Some(data) = data {
        for (name, state) in &data.states {
            let n =
                u64::try_from(name.len()).map_err(|_| Schema(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
            charge_schema(
                charge,
                n.checked_add(128)
                    .ok_or(Schema(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?,
                0,
            )
            .map_err(Schema)?;
            states.push(present_state(name, data, state, defaults));
        }
    }
    Ok(CompletePolicyPresentation::All {
        workflow_type,
        generation,
        version,
        max_active_ms,
        retry,
        retention,
        indexed_attributes,
        indexed_state_meta,
        governance,
        states,
    })
}

fn present_retry<'v>(
    type_retry: Option<&'v RetryOverride>,
    state: Option<&'v CompleteStatePolicyData>,
) -> PresentedRetry<'v> {
    let state_retry = state.and_then(|state| state.retry.as_ref());
    PresentedRetry {
        max_retries: state_retry
            .and_then(|retry| retry.max_retries)
            .or_else(|| type_retry.and_then(|retry| retry.max_retries))
            .unwrap_or(3),
        backoff: state_retry
            .and_then(|retry| retry.backoff)
            .or_else(|| type_retry.and_then(|retry| retry.backoff))
            .unwrap_or_default(),
        exhausted_to: state_retry
            .and_then(|retry| retry.exhausted_to.as_deref())
            .or_else(|| type_retry.and_then(|retry| retry.exhausted_to.as_deref()))
            .unwrap_or(b"failed"),
    }
}

fn present_retention(
    mut defaults: ResolvedRetention,
    type_retention: Option<RetentionOverride>,
    state: Option<&CompleteStatePolicyData>,
) -> ResolvedRetention {
    for retention in [type_retention, state.and_then(|state| state.retention)]
        .into_iter()
        .flatten()
    {
        crate::retention::merge(&mut defaults, retention);
    }
    defaults
}

fn present_state<'v>(
    name: &'v [u8],
    data: &'v CompletePolicyData,
    state: &'v CompleteStatePolicyData,
    defaults: ResolvedRetention,
) -> PresentedPolicyState<'v> {
    PresentedPolicyState {
        state: name,
        mode: state.mode.unwrap_or(StateMode::Parallel),
        max_active_ms: data.max_active_ms,
        retry: present_retry(data.retry.as_ref(), Some(state)),
        retention: present_retention(defaults, data.retention, Some(state)),
        governance: state.governance.as_ref(),
    }
}

//! Claim ownership controls; private unit fixtures certify only pure plans.

use super::{CommittedCommand, EventKind, Fence, LatestEvent, Operation, Outcome};
use super::{TestResult, TimestampMillis, WorkflowRecord, queued, reduce};
use crate::claim::Claim;
use crate::history::HistoryEntry;
use crate::lease::{Lease, LeaseToken};
use wf_types::identity::RecordId;

#[test]
fn claim_and_reclaim_preserve_retained_owners_and_exact_history() -> TestResult {
    for (payload, result, error) in [
        (None, None, None),
        (Some(vec![]), Some(vec![]), Some(vec![])),
        (
            Some(vec![0, 255, 7]),
            Some(vec![255, 0, 8]),
            Some(vec![9, 0, 255]),
        ),
        (Some(vec![0, 255, 7]), None, Some(vec![])),
    ] {
        for (saved, expected_saved) in [
            (None, b"queued".as_slice()),
            (Some(vec![]), b"queued".as_slice()),
            (Some(vec![255, 0, 1]), [255, 0, 1].as_slice()),
        ] {
            for reclaim in [false, true] {
                let record = claim_ownership_record(&payload, &result, &error, &saved, reclaim)?;
                let before = record.clone();
                let operation = Claim {
                    expected_state: record.state.clone(),
                    worker: vec![0, 255, 3],
                    token: LeaseToken::new(vec![255, 0, 4])?,
                    lease_ms: 5,
                };
                let command = CommittedCommand {
                    id: record.id.clone(),
                    now: TimestampMillis::new(50),
                    operation: if reclaim {
                        Operation::Reclaim(operation)
                    } else {
                        Operation::Claim(operation)
                    },
                };
                let expected = WorkflowRecord {
                    id: RecordId::new(b"counter-boundary".to_vec())?,
                    workflow_type: b"type".to_vec(),
                    state: b"running".to_vec(),
                    version: 8,
                    fence: Fence::new(12),
                    attempts: 13,
                    created_at: TimestampMillis::new(4),
                    updated_at: TimestampMillis::new(50),
                    next_run_at: Some(TimestampMillis::new(55)),
                    run_state: Some(if reclaim {
                        expected_saved.to_vec()
                    } else {
                        vec![255, 0, 2]
                    }),
                    lease: Some(Lease {
                        worker: vec![0, 255, 3],
                        token: LeaseToken::new(vec![255, 0, 4])?,
                        deadline: TimestampMillis::new(55),
                    }),
                    payload: payload.clone(),
                    result: result.clone(),
                    error: error.clone(),
                    latest_event: LatestEvent {
                        kind: EventKind::Claimed,
                        version: 8,
                        fence: Fence::new(12),
                    },
                };
                let expected_history = HistoryEntry {
                    event_id: "50-8".into(),
                    kind: EventKind::Claimed,
                    occurred_at: TimestampMillis::new(50),
                    version: 8,
                    fence: Fence::new(12),
                    attempts: 13,
                    state: b"running".to_vec(),
                    next_run_at: Some(TimestampMillis::new(55)),
                    lease_deadline: TimestampMillis::new(55),
                    worker: Some(vec![0, 255, 3]),
                    retry: None,
                };
                let plan = reduce(Some(&record), &command)?;
                assert_eq!(plan.outcome(), Outcome::Changed);
                let write = plan.write().ok_or("ownership write absent")?;
                assert_eq!(write.expected_version, Some(7));
                assert_eq!(write.record, expected);
                assert_eq!(plan.history(), Some(&expected_history));
                assert_eq!(plan, reduce(Some(&record), &command)?);
                assert_eq!(record, before);
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn claim_ownership_record(
    payload: &Option<Vec<u8>>,
    result: &Option<Vec<u8>>,
    error: &Option<Vec<u8>>,
    saved: &Option<Vec<u8>>,
    reclaim: bool,
) -> Result<WorkflowRecord, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let mut record = queued()?;
    record.state = if reclaim {
        b"running".to_vec()
    } else {
        vec![255, 0, 2]
    };
    record.version = 7;
    record.fence = Fence::new(11);
    record.attempts = 13;
    record.created_at = TimestampMillis::new(4);
    record.updated_at = TimestampMillis::new(9);
    record.next_run_at = Some(TimestampMillis::new(50));
    record.run_state = saved.clone();
    record.payload = payload.clone();
    record.result = result.clone();
    record.error = error.clone();
    record.latest_event = LatestEvent {
        kind: EventKind::Created,
        version: 7,
        fence: Fence::new(11),
    };
    record.lease = if reclaim {
        Some(Lease {
            worker: vec![255; 1_024],
            token: LeaseToken::new(vec![0; 128])?,
            deadline: TimestampMillis::new(50),
        })
    } else {
        None
    };
    Ok(record)
}

```rust
//! Ordinary create and mutation of one explicitly selected claim candidate.

use wf_types::version::Fence;

use crate::claim::Claim;
use crate::history::{EventKind, LatestEvent};
use crate::lease::Lease;
use crate::value::{Counter, InputField};

use super::plan::{changed_plan, noop_plan};
use super::validation::{
    lease_deadline, next_version, require_nonempty, retry_run_state, terminal_state,
    validate_run_at,
};
use super::{CommittedCommand, Create, DomainError, Outcome, TransitionPlan, WorkflowRecord};

pub(super) fn create_record(
    record: Option<&WorkflowRecord>,
    command: &CommittedCommand,
    create: &Create,
) -> Result<TransitionPlan, DomainError> {
    require_nonempty(&create.workflow_type, InputField::Type)?;
    if create.workflow_type == b"__ferricstore_schedule" {
        return Err(DomainError::ReservedType);
    }
    require_nonempty(&create.state, InputField::State)?;
    if create.state == b"running" {
        return Err(DomainError::RunningTransition);
    }
    let run_at = create.run_at.unwrap_or(command.now);
    validate_run_at(run_at)?;
    if record.is_some() {
        return Err(DomainError::AlreadyExists);
    }
    let next = WorkflowRecord {
        id: command.id.clone(),
        workflow_type: create.workflow_type.clone(),
        state: create.state.clone(),
        version: 1,
        fence: Fence::new(0),
        attempts: 0,
        created_at: command.now,
        updated_at: command.now,
        next_run_at: Some(run_at),
        run_state: None,
        lease: None,
        payload: create.payload.clone(),
        result: None,
        error: None,
        latest_event: LatestEvent {
            kind: EventKind::Created,
            version: 1,
            fence: Fence::new(0),
        },
    };
    Ok(changed_plan(None, next, EventKind::Created, command.now))
}

pub(super) fn claim_record(
    record: &WorkflowRecord,
    command: &CommittedCommand,
    claim: &Claim,
    reclaim: bool,
) -> Result<TransitionPlan, DomainError> {
    require_nonempty(&claim.expected_state, InputField::State)?;
    require_nonempty(&claim.worker, InputField::Worker)?;
    let deadline = lease_deadline(command.now, claim.lease_ms)?;
    let ownership_eligible = if reclaim {
        record.state == b"running" && record.lease.is_some()
    } else {
        record.state != b"running" && record.lease.is_none()
    };
    if record.state != claim.expected_state
        || !ownership_eligible
        || terminal_state(&record.state)
        || record.next_run_at.is_none_or(|run_at| run_at > command.now)
    {
        return Ok(noop_plan(Outcome::NotEligible));
    }
    let version = next_version(record)?;
    let fence = record
        .fence
        .checked_next()
        .ok_or(DomainError::CounterOverflow(Counter::Fence))?;
    let next = WorkflowRecord {
        id: record.id.clone(),
        workflow_type: record.workflow_type.clone(),
        state: b"running".to_vec(),
        version,
        fence,
        attempts: record.attempts,
        created_at: record.created_at,
        updated_at: command.now,
        next_run_at: Some(deadline),
        run_state: Some(if reclaim {
            retry_run_state(record).to_vec()
        } else {
            record.state.clone()
        }),
        lease: Some(Lease {
            worker: claim.worker.clone(),
            token: claim.token.clone(),
            deadline,
        }),
        payload: record.payload.clone(),
        result: record.result.clone(),
        error: record.error.clone(),
        latest_event: record.latest_event,
    };
    Ok(changed_plan(
        Some(record),
        next,
        EventKind::Claimed,
        command.now,
    ))
}
```

//! Borrowed original Replace admission and paid mathematical header restoration.

use wf_types::identity::{GroupId, RecoveryId, RequestId, TenantId};
use wf_types::version::CommittedTime;

use crate::workflow::admission::AdmissionLimits;
use crate::workflow::request::{ClientIntent, RequestScope};

use super::super::admission::charge_schema;
use super::super::{
    CompletePolicyEncodingError, PolicySchemaCharge, PolicySchemaError, PolicySchemaLimits,
};
use super::CompletePolicyRequestError;

mod scan;

pub(super) use scan::check_replace_frame_lists;

/// Immutable structure from one original frame; carries no account or paid credit.
pub struct ScannedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame<'a> {
    encoded: &'a [u8],
    original_intent: &'a [u8],
    tenant: &'a [u8],
    group: &'a [u8],
    recovery: &'a [u8],
    request: &'a [u8],
    stamp: CommittedTime,
    intent_digest: [u8; 32],
}

impl<'a> ScannedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame<'a> {
    /// Borrows the exact original complete original request identity bytes for recomputation.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn original_intent(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
        self.original_intent
    }

    fn restore_header(
        self,
        charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
    ) -> Result<CompletePolicyReplaceFrameHeader<'a>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        let ScannedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame {
            encoded,
            original_intent,
            tenant,
            group,
            recovery,
            request,
            stamp,
            intent_digest,
        } = self;
        charge_schema(charge, 128, 0)?;
        charge_schema(charge, 128, 0)?;
        let tenant = TenantId::new(copy_replace_header_field(tenant, charge)?)
            .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed))?;
        let group = GroupId::new(copy_replace_header_field(group, charge)?)
            .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed))?;
        let recovery = RecoveryId::new(copy_replace_header_field(recovery, charge)?)
            .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed))?;
        let scope = RequestScope::new(tenant, group, recovery);
        let request = RequestId::new(copy_replace_header_field(request, charge)?)
            .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed))?;
        Ok(CompletePolicyReplaceFrameHeader {
            encoded,
            original_intent,
            scope,
            request,
            stamp,
            intent: ClientIntent::complete_policy_replace(intent_digest),
        })
    }
}

/// Owned identities and borrowed original bytes, without prepared-frame authority.
pub struct CompletePolicyReplaceFrameHeader<'a> {
    encoded: &'a [u8],
    original_intent: &'a [u8],
    scope: RequestScope,
    request: RequestId,
    stamp: CommittedTime,
    intent: ClientIntent,
}

impl<'a> CompletePolicyReplaceFrameHeader<'a> {
    /// Borrows the same complete original frame.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn encoded(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
        self.encoded
    }

    /// Borrows the original complete original request, without materializing a Patch.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn original_intent(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
        self.original_intent
    }

    /// Borrows independently owned validated namespace identities.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn scope(&self) -> &RequestScope {
        &self.scope
    }

    /// Borrows the original caller request identity.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn request(&self) -> &RequestId {
        &self.request
    }

    /// Reads the structurally validated committed stamp.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn stamp(&self) -> CommittedTime {
        self.stamp
    }

    /// Reads the supplied intent after its paid recomputed-digest comparison.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn intent(&self) -> ClientIntent {
        self.intent
    }
}

/// Scans one complete original frame through the received schema account.
///
/// The result is mathematical structure, with no hash computation or paid credit.
/// Structural scope admission precedes intent recomputation and all owned headers.
///
/// # Errors
/// Preserves profile, frame, scope, wire, work and checked-length refusals.
pub fn scan_complete_policy_replace_frame<'a>(
    encoded: &'a [u8],
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<ScannedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame<'a>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    if charge.profile() != limits {
        return Err(PolicySchemaError::ProfileMismatch.into());
    }
    if encoded.len() > admission.decision_bytes() {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit.into());
    }
    let (scanned, inner_tenant) = scan::scan_frame(encoded, limits, charge)?;
    let comparison = scanned
        .tenant
        .len()
        .checked_add(inner_tenant.len())
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    let comparison = comparison
        .checked_add(128)
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    let comparison = u64::try_from(comparison).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    charge_schema(charge, comparison, 0)?;
    if scanned.tenant != inner_tenant {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed.into());
    }
    let bytes =
        u64::try_from(scanned.original_intent.len()).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    let hash = bytes
        .checked_add(128)
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    charge_schema(charge, hash, 0)?;
    Ok(scanned)
}

/// Consumes one same-frame view after fresh comparison and header/tail admissions.
///
/// No grammar scan is repeated. This header cannot mint a ports Verified value.
/// Public calls do not establish account identity; the closed raw ports entry
/// threads its actual account through every scan, comparison, copy and tail.
///
/// # Errors
/// Rechecks profile/frame caps, then preserves digest, copy and work refusals.
pub fn restore_complete_policy_replace_frame_header<'a>(
    scanned: ScannedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame<'a>,
    recomputed: [u8; 32],
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<CompletePolicyReplaceFrameHeader<'a>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    if charge.profile() != limits {
        return Err(PolicySchemaError::ProfileMismatch.into());
    }
    if scanned.encoded.len() > admission.decision_bytes() {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit.into());
    }
    charge_schema(charge, 192, 0)?;
    if recomputed != scanned.intent_digest {
        return Err(CompletePolicyRequestError::IntentMismatch);
    }
    let header = scanned.restore_header(charge)?;
    prepay_replace_frame_tail(&header, charge)?;
    Ok(header)
}

fn copy_replace_header_field(
    bytes: &[u8],
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let bytes_len = u64::try_from(bytes.len()).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    let work = bytes_len
        .checked_add(128)
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    charge_schema(charge, work, 0)?;
    let mut copied = Vec::new();
    copied
        .try_reserve_exact(bytes.len())
        .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::AllocationFailure))?;
    copied.extend_from_slice(bytes);
    Ok(copied)
}

fn prepay_replace_frame_tail(
    header: &CompletePolicyReplaceFrameHeader<'_>,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    charge_schema(charge, 128, 0)?;
    let isolation = header
        .scope
        .tenant()
        .as_bytes()
        .len()
        .checked_add(header.scope.group().as_bytes().len())
        .ok_or(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit)?;
    let isolation = isolation
        .checked_add(header.scope.recovery().as_bytes().len())
        .ok_or(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit)?;
    let isolation = isolation
        .checked_add(18)
        .ok_or(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit)?;
    if isolation > 8_192 {
        return Err(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit);
    }
    let bytes = u64::try_from(isolation).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    // Distinct scope measure, reserve, and emission occurrences.
    for base in [512, 128, 512] {
        let work = bytes
            .checked_add(base)
            .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
        charge_schema(charge, work, 0)?;
    }
    let frame_len =
        u64::try_from(header.encoded.len()).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    let frame = frame_len
        .checked_add(128)
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    charge_schema(charge, frame, 0)?;
    Ok(())
}

//! Original Replace grammar and separately paid borrowed list uniqueness.

use std::collections::BTreeSet;

use wf_types::version::{CommittedTime, HlcTimestamp};

use super::super::super::admission::charge_schema;
use super::super::super::encoding::reader::Reader;
use super::super::super::encoding::scan::scan_data_fields;
use super::super::super::{
    CompletePolicyData, CompletePolicyEncodingError, GovernanceData, PolicySchemaCharge,
    PolicySchemaError, PolicySchemaLimits,
};
use super::{CompletePolicyRequestError, ScannedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame};

pub(super) fn scan_frame<'a>(
    encoded: &'a [u8],
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<(ScannedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame<'a>, &'a [u8]), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let (scanned, inner_tenant) = {
        let mut reader = Reader::new(encoded, limits, charge);
        reader.node()?;
        if reader.take(4)? != b"FWCP" {
            return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed.into());
        }
        if reader.u16()? != 1 {
            return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedVersion.into());
        }
        if reader.byte()? != 6 {
            return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedTag.into());
        }
        let tenant = reader.raw(8_192)?;
        tenant
            .first()
            .ok_or(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed)?;
        let group = reader.raw(256)?;
        group
            .first()
            .ok_or(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed)?;
        let recovery = reader.raw(256)?;
        recovery
            .first()
            .ok_or(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed)?;
        let isolation = tenant
            .len()
            .checked_add(group.len())
            .ok_or(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit)?;
        let isolation = isolation
            .checked_add(recovery.len())
            .ok_or(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit)?;
        let isolation = isolation
            .checked_add(18)
            .ok_or(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit)?;
        if isolation > 8_192 {
            return Err(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit);
        }
        let request = reader.raw(256)?;
        request
            .first()
            .ok_or(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed)?;
        if reader.u16()? != 2 {
            return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedVersion.into());
        }
        let intent_digest = reader
            .take(32)?
            .try_into()
            .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed))?;
        let hlc = HlcTimestamp::new(reader.u64()?, reader.u16()?)
            .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed))?;
        let stamp = CommittedTime::new(hlc, reader.u64()?)
            .or(Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed))?;
        reader.node()?;
        let declared = reader.u32()?;
        if declared > 1_048_576 {
            return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit.into());
        }
        let n = usize::try_from(declared).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
        let start = reader.position();
        let end = start
            .checked_add(n)
            .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
        if end > encoded.len() {
            return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed.into());
        }
        if end < encoded.len() {
            return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::TrailingBytes.into());
        }
        let original_intent = &encoded[start..end];
        let inner_tenant = {
            let mut intent = reader.region(start..end)?;
            let tenant = scan_intent(&mut intent)?;
            intent.finish()?;
            tenant
        };
        let scanned = ScannedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame {
            encoded,
            original_intent,
            tenant,
            group,
            recovery,
            request,
            stamp,
            intent_digest,
        };
        (scanned, inner_tenant)
    };
    Ok((scanned, inner_tenant))
}

fn scan_intent<'a>(reader: &mut Reader<'a, '_>) -> Result<&'a [u8], CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    reader.node()?;
    if reader.take(30)? != b"WF-INTENT\0COMPLETE-REPLACE\0V2\0" {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed);
    }
    let tenant = reader.raw(8_192)?;
    if tenant.is_empty() {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed);
    }
    reader.optional(Reader::u64)?;
    reader.node()?;
    scan_data_fields(reader)?;
    Ok(tenant)
}

pub(in crate::policy::complete::outer) fn check_replace_frame_lists(
    data: &CompletePolicyData,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    charge_schema(charge, 128, 0)?;
    for state in data.states.values() {
        charge_schema(charge, 128, 0)?;
        if let Some(governance) = &state.governance {
            check_replace_governance_lists(governance, charge)?;
        }
    }
    if let Some(names) = &data.indexed_attributes {
        check_replace_frame_names(names, charge)?;
    }
    if let Some(governance) = &data.governance {
        check_replace_governance_lists(governance, charge)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn check_replace_governance_lists(
    data: &GovernanceData,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    charge_schema(charge, 128, 0)?;
    if let Some(effects) = &data.effects {
        charge_schema(charge, 128, 0)?;
        for names in [&effects.allowed, &effects.denied].into_iter().flatten() {
            check_replace_frame_names(names, charge)?;
        }
    }
    if let Some(circuits) = &data.circuits {
        charge_schema(charge, 128, 0)?;
        for circuit in circuits.values() {
            charge_schema(charge, 128, 0)?;
            if let Some(names) = &circuit.error_classes {
                check_replace_frame_names(names, charge)?;
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(approvals) = &data.approvals {
        charge_schema(charge, 128, 0)?;
        for names in [&approvals.effects, &approvals.states, &approvals.assignees]
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
        {
            check_replace_frame_names(names, charge)?;
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn check_replace_frame_names(
    names: &[Vec<u8>],
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    charge_schema(charge, 128, 0)?;
    let scratch = u64::try_from(names.len())
        .ok()
        .and_then(|n| n.checked_mul(64))
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    charge_schema(charge, 0, scratch)?;
    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
    for name in names {
        let work = u64::try_from(name.len())
            .ok()
            .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(128))
            .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
        charge_schema(charge, work, 0)?;
        if !seen.insert(name.as_slice()) {
            return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed.into());
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
